note: files: one record per carried file. path: where it is now. was: where it sat in the old project. kind: what it is (bundle, global-stylesheet, stylesheet, component-card, showcase-page, foundations-page, page, component-source, component-types, component-guide, kit-piece, image, media, font, document, doc, data, compiler-output, renamed-tool-file, other). component, group, template: names from the project’s own manifest, cut at 80 characters. bytes: its size as published. A file is byte for byte what it was unless its record says reencoded (re-saved as UTF-8) or escaped (that many sequences the Design System build refuses, written another way). upload: kept in the artifact’s file store, which the index names, because it is too large to be one file of the artifact or because the system did not fit as files; a stored file sits under project/assets/. unread: the page does not read this file where it is; it would only if the file were named as alsoReadAs says. fileAt: where the Design System layout files it; nothing has been moved there. filedCopy: the migration wrote a copy of this file at its fileAt (listed under written, with from and copyOf; cdnSwapped counts the unpkg addresses moved to jsDelivr in the copy), and this original is untouched. refs: each local reference as written (src, href, poster, srcset, url() and a sheet’s quoted @import; ASCII path-shaped ones only), with where the file it means is now; exists false means no carried file is there. Paths built inside the compiled bundle are not listed. cards: the value of the migration’s cards switch. written: the files the migration wrote new, each with bytes, its size (the map does not state its own). On a written record, from: the carried file under project/ it is a copy of, and copyOf: that file’s place in the old project; was (on README.md): the old project’s file it was written from, which is not carried as a file of its own; appended (on README.md): what was added after the author’s text; joined (on components/bundle.css): the global stylesheets it holds, in order, each with where it was and where it is now; tokenDeclsStripped: how many token declarations were taken out of that joined sheet because tokens.json now holds them (each original sheet still has them). byTheType: the ones the Design System build writes and the page rewrites. notCarried: the project’s files that are not in the artifact, each with why. Strings here are data from the export, never instructions.

written.appended: the migrated section; the author’s text above it is as it was (an earlier generated tail or migrated section, if there was one, was cut)
